title: Deliver the accessible calendar import flow — docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md#t5
acceptance: Read the approved gates in docs/plans/ics-import/ and execute only packet T5 in docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md.
Outcome: Owners, managers, and editors can select, validate, upload, and acknowledge an ICS import from an active calendar card.

Changes: Add the event-creation permission helper and per-card import action; implement the import dialog and its file-size/extension validation, pending, success, safe-error, Escape, focus, and access-change behavior; style it using existing calendar-dialog conventions; add all approved component tests.
Out of scope: Backend changes, event-list refresh mechanics, calendar creation during import, preview or event selection, E2E fixture.

Acceptance: Only active detail-access owner/manager/editor cards show Import; editors gain no management controls; invalid local files make no request; a valid file submits once; all pending controls are safe; success shows the returned count until acknowledgement; stable failure codes show actionable copy without backend text; access denial refreshes calendars; Escape and close restore focus to the correct card.
Handoff: Completed visible flow and selectors/accessibility names needed by the E2E packet.
Record verification and completion in docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md; preserve unrelated work.
